questions.q:
If A = 43 + 83 + 123 + .... + 443 and B = 122 + 182 + 242 + .... + 542, then what is the difference between unit digit of A and B?

यदि A = 43 + 83 + 123 + .... + 443 और B = 122 + 182 + 242 + .... + 542 है, तो A और B के इकाई अंक के बीच का अंतर क्या है?
questions.s:
A = 43 + 83 + 123 + .... + 443

A = 64 * (13 + 23 +33 + ... + 113)

Here, we know that, (13 + 23 + 33 + ... + n3) = (n(n + 1)/2)2

Then, A = 64 * ((11(11 + 1)/2)2) = 278784

Unit digit of A = 4

Similarly, B = 122 + 182 + 242 + .... + 542

B = 36 * ((22 + 32 + 42 + ... + 92) - 12)

Here, we know that, (12 + 22 + 32 + ... + n2) = n(n + 1)(2n + 1)/6

Then, B = 36 * ((9(9 + 1)(18 + 1)/6) - 1) = 10224

Unit digit of B = 4

Therefore, difference between unit digit of A and B = 4 - 4 = 0

questions.q:
Which of the following can be express as the sum of two prime numbers?

निम्नलिखित में से किसे दो अभाज्य संख्याओं के योग के रूप में व्यक्त किया जा सकता है?
questions.s:
Checking through options,

Option 1: 23

Let 23 = X + Y, where X and Y are two prime numbers. Since 23 is odd, one of X and Y must be 2. But in such case, the other number will be 21, which is not a prime number. Therefore, 23 cannot be expressed as the sum of two primes.

Option 2: 29

Let 29 = X + Y, where X and Y are two prime numbers. Since 29 is odd, one of X and Y must be 2. But in such case, the other number will be 27, which is not a prime number. Therefore, 29 cannot be expressed as the sum of two primes.

Option 3: 33

Let 33 = X + Y, where X and Y are two prime numbers. Since 33 is odd, one of X and Y must be 2. And the other number will be 31, which is also a prime number. Therefore, 33 can be expressed as the sum of two primes.

Option 4: 47

Let 47 = X + Y, where X and Y are two prime numbers. Since 47 is odd, one of X and Y must be 2. But in such case, the other number will be 45, which is not a prime number. Therefore, 47 cannot be expressed as the sum of two primes.

questions.q:
Find the unit digit.

(847)123 - (6925)46 + (1307)89 - (5748)132 + (396)57

इकाई अंक ज्ञात करें।

(847)123 - (6925)46 + (1307)89 - (5748)132 + (396)57
questions.s:
• (847)123 → 7; cycle [7,9,3,1]; 123 mod 4 = 3 → unit digit = 3

• - (6925)46 → last digit 5 → always 5 → 3 - 5 = - 2 → unit digit = 8

• +(1307)89 → last digit 7; cycle [7,9,3,1]; 89 mod 4 = 1 → 7 → 8 + 7 = 15 → unit digit = 5

• - (5748)132 → last digit 8; cycle [8,4,2,6]; 132 mod 4 = 0 → 6 → 5 - 6 = - 1 → unit digit = 9

• +(396)57 → last digit 6 → always 6 → 9 + 6 = 15 → unit digit = 5

questions_hin.q_hi: 13. वह सबसे छोटी प्राकृतिक संख्या ज्ञात करें जो 15, 63, 21 और 70 से विभाज्य है।
questions_hin.s_hi:
13.(b) 15 → 3 × 5
63 → 3 × 3 × 7
21→ 3 × 7
70 → 2 × 5 × 7
LCM (15, 63, 21 और 70) = 2 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 7 = 630
∴ 15, 63, 21 और 70 से विभाज्य होने वाली सबसे छोटी संख्या = 630

questions_hin.q_hi:
Which of the following can be express as the sum of two prime numbers?

निम्नलिखित में से किसे दो अभाज्य संख्याओं के योग के रूप में व्यक्त किया जा सकता है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Checking through options,

Option 1: 23

Let 23 = X + Y, where X and Y are two prime numbers. Since 23 is odd, one of X and Y must be 2. But in such case, the other number will be 21, which is not a prime number. Therefore, 23 cannot be expressed as the sum of two primes.

Option 2: 29

Let 29 = X + Y, where X and Y are two prime numbers. Since 29 is odd, one of X and Y must be 2. But in such case, the other number will be 27, which is not a prime number. Therefore, 29 cannot be expressed as the sum of two primes.

Option 3: 33

Let 33 = X + Y, where X and Y are two prime numbers. Since 33 is odd, one of X and Y must be 2. And the other number will be 31, which is also a prime number. Therefore, 33 can be expressed as the sum of two primes.

Option 4: 47

Let 47 = X + Y, where X and Y are two prime numbers. Since 47 is odd, one of X and Y must be 2. But in such case, the other number will be 45, which is not a prime number. Therefore, 47 cannot be expressed as the sum of two primes.

questions_hin.q_hi:
Four bells toll once every 8 seconds, 10 seconds, 15 seconds and 27 seconds respectively. If all the bells together toll at 7:00 am, then they will toll together next at -

चार घंटियाँ क्रमशः हर 8 सेकंड, 10 सेकंड, 15 सेकंड और 27 सेकंड में एक बार बजती हैं। यदि सभी घंटियाँ एक साथ सुबह 7:00 बजे बजेंगी, तो वे अगली बार एक साथ बजेंगी -
questions_hin.s_hi:
LCM of 8, 10, 15 and 27 = 1080 s = 18 minutes

Required time = 7:00 am + 18 minutes = 7:18 am

questions_hin.q_hi: 14. यदि सात अंकों की संख्या 49x29y6, 72 से विभाज्य है, तो x और y के सबसे बड़े मान के लिए (x + 2y) का मान क्या होगा ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
14.(b)

दी गई संख्या 49x29y6 है।

72 = 8 × 9

अंकों का योग = 4 + 9 + x + 2 + 9 + y + 6 = 30 + x + y

9 के लिए, 30 + x + y, 9 से विभाज्य होना चाहिए।

x + y = 6 या 15

8 के लिए, 9y6, 8 से विभाज्य होना चाहिए।

y = 3 या 7

सबसे बड़े मान के लिए हमारे पास y = 7,

x = 15 – 7 = 8 है।

x + 2y = 8 + 2 × 7 = 22

questions_hin.q_hi:
Find the unit digit.

(847)123 - (6925)46 + (1307)89 - (5748)132 + (396)57

इकाई अंक ज्ञात करें।

(847)123 - (6925)46 + (1307)89 - (5748)132 + (396)57
questions_hin.s_hi:
• (847)123 → 7; cycle [7,9,3,1]; 123 mod 4 = 3 → unit digit = 3

• - (6925)46 → last digit 5 → always 5 → 3 - 5 = - 2 → unit digit = 8

• +(1307)89 → last digit 7; cycle [7,9,3,1]; 89 mod 4 = 1 → 7 → 8 + 7 = 15 → unit digit = 5

• - (5748)132 → last digit 8; cycle [8,4,2,6]; 132 mod 4 = 0 → 6 → 5 - 6 = - 1 → unit digit = 9

• +(396)57 → last digit 6 → always 6 → 9 + 6 = 15 → unit digit = 5
